subject: Instrumentation runbook & cost-stability matrix: Console endpoint exceptions
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Instrumentation runbook & cost-stability matrix: Console endpoint exceptions

Team —

We had two customer incidents in the last month where Console dashboards reported an endpoint "exception" (spike in per-token cost + tail latency) but by the time SRE opened a Pager we couldn't reproduce the cost impact or attribute to a tenant. Sales (Marissa) flagged this as a commercial risk for customers who are sensitive to unexpected token spend.

Ask: can we put together an operational runbook + a lightweight "cost-stability matrix" that product/CS/ops all use when an endpoint shows a cost/latency anomaly? I sketched a template (attached) — we need this to be actionable: signal -> probable cause -> immediate mitigation -> long-term fix -> owner.

What I'm looking for from you both:
- Markus: what infra telemetry we already have (per-route token counters, model-fallback events, cache hit/miss, autoscaler activity) and what we'd need to add for reliable attribution.
- Karthik: what Console-level UI/queries would be needed so product/CS can triage without opening internal tickets (e.g., per-tenant token breakdown, last-24h model variant mix).
- Grace / Marissa: what fields do customers and sales need in exported reports? Example: per-tenant daily token delta + related SDK version.

Goal: 2-week spike to get a minimal playbook + one sample dashboard and a CSV export for Sales. If we can agree on scope today, can we target a spike start next Monday?

Attachments: cost-stability-matrix-template.csv (skeleton), console-exception-sample.png (screenshot of last incident).

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation runbook & cost-stability matrix: Console endpoint exceptions

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 09:12 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
>
> We had two customer incidents in the last month where Console dashboards reported an endpoint "exception" (spike in per-token cost + tail latency) but by the time SRE opened a Pager we couldn't reproduce the cost impact or attribute to a tenant...

Thanks for the clear write-up, Lauren. I like the skeleton template. A couple of pragmatic suggestions for the matrix columns so the runbook is immediately actionable:

- Signal (e.g., token-per-second spike, 95th tail latency, model-fallback rate increase, cache-miss %)
- Severity (P0/P1/Urgent/Info) — include how to map to Pager thresholds
- Threshold (absolute or relative; e.g., >3x baseline or >50% increase)
- Suggested immediate mitigation (e.g., pin to smaller model variant, enable per-tenant rate-limit, enable cache warm-up)
- Owner (SRE/Product/CS)
- Escalation path (Slack channel, on-call alias, EM contact)
- Evidence queries (promQL/kusto snippet + quick instructions)
- Confidence/Notes (how sure we are that signal -> cause mapping is reliable)

Telem: we have token-rate counters at the host/process level and model-serving events, but we do not consistently tag requests with "route"+"tenant" across the entire stack for async batch joins. Minimum instrumentation to add for the spike: propagate route_id + tenant_id through the request lifecycle and emit a sampled detailed trace for 1-in-100 requests when anomaly is detected.

Question for Marissa/Grace: what sampling cadence balances Sales' need for attribution vs. data volume? If Sales wants daily per-tenant deltas across all tenants, we should consider an aggregated export rather than full traces.

I can take the first pass on the Evidence queries and a prom/kusto snippet by EOD Monday. Markus — can you confirm feasibility of the 1-in-100 anomaly sampling?

—Karthik
Senior Product Engineer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation runbook & cost-stability matrix: Console endpoint exceptions

Quick note from the commercial side — two items worth calling out:

1) Customer impact framing: Alex Jenkins at Acme (cc'ed in the original incident thread) flagged the first spike as "unexpected billing". His ask: an export that shows for any day with an alert a per-tenant hour-by-hour token delta and the top-3 correlated signals (model changes, SDK version, dev key). If we can provide that as a CSV/S3 export, it reduces churn with Finance/Procurement.

2) Prioritization: for the spike please prioritize (a) accurate per-tenant attribution and (b) a simple downloadable CSV for Sales/Finance. UI dashboards are great but exports are the minimum deliverable for customers.

For sampling: daily aggregated deltas + 1-in-100 sampled traces should be sufficient; we can ask customers for narrower windows if they want deeper audits.

Marissa
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation runbook & cost-stability matrix: Console endpoint exceptions

Lauren / all —

We can own the infra signals and the sampling spike. Quick responses to the ask:

- Feasibility: adding propagation of route_id + tenant_id is straightforward but will touch the request proxy + worker join path. I estimate a 2-week spike (1 week infra changes + 1 week dashboard/export work) with a single engineer + SRE on-call support.
- Sampling: 1-in-100 sampled full trace on anomaly is doable; we'll also emit aggregated per-tenant counters every 5 minutes to a hot-timeseries store for fast queries. That should allow the CSV export Marissa wants without storing full traces long-term.
- Playbook: we'll structure the runbook as Karthik suggested. I attached a quick snapshot of the prototype dashboard (see attachment).
- Next step: 30-minute sync Wednesday to agree scope and owners, then spin up a ticket (SUP-4521) and start the spike next Monday.

Action items assigned: Markus (implement sampling + counters), Karthik (evidence queries + playbook draft), Grace (dashboard + export template), Marissa (customer export schema).

Thanks —
Markus
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: console-exception-sample.png (dashboard snapshot)
